description_html:
A charming example of a well sought-after Type F1A studio apartment on the first floor of John Trundle Court in the Barbican with a bright, west-facing view. The kitchen and bathroom have been renovated to reflect a more contemporary style, with certain original elements retained such as the Garchey food disposal.

Floor to ceiling windows in this west-facing studio allow an abundance of natural light into the space, particularly in the afternoon and evening. Residents can avail of many other amenities that the estate has to offer, such as 24/7 porterage through the building's car park, a private residents garden, bicycle storage, tennis courts and storage facilities. Storage and parking is available by separate negotiation with the Barbican Estate Office.

This flat is situated a brief walk away from the Hammersmith & City, Circle and Metropolitan lines at Barbican Station, as well as the Elizabeth Line at Farringdon Station. There is an array of bars, shops and restaurants to choose from in nearby Clerkenwell, or 10 minutes walk away along Cheapside.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 80
Service Charge: £3,399 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £10
